Automotive and discrete plants chase three numbers — OEE, escapes and launch time. Sensor fabric, vision inspection and scheduling intelligence move all three simultaneously, while IATF traceability and IT/OT security raise the baseline every program must respect.

items: Defect detection by eyes/sampling; escapes reach customers and recalls cost millions.
Legacy lines uninstrumented; OEE components and energy per unit are estimates.

Governance inherits the sector frame — IATF 16949 among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Own your models — tune, distill and operate LLMs with measurable quality, controlled cost and enforceable policy.
